endorsements.name: Ashutosh Barot
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-5638
endorsements.description: Rapid7 Nexpose versions 6.5.50 and prior suffer from insufficient session expiration when an administrator performs a security relevant edit on an existing, logged on user. For example, if a user's password is changed by an administrator due to an otherwise unrelated credential leak, that user account's current session is still valid after the password change, potentially allowing the attacker who originally compromised the credential to remain logged in and able to cause further damage.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.7)

endorsements.name: Ashutosh Barot
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-3844
endorsements.description: Rapid7 InsightVM suffers from insufficient session expiration when an administrator performs a security relevant edit on an existing, logged on user. For example, if a user's password is changed by an administrator due to an otherwise unrelated credential leak, that user account's current session is still valid after the password change, potentially allowing the attacker who originally compromised the credential to remain logged in and able to cause further damage.  This vulnerability is mitigated by the use of the Platform Login feature. This issue is related to CVE-2019-5638.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.7)
